classes/archivist-74.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/archivist-74.description: Proficient with all simple weapons and with light and medium armor, but not shields.

classes/archivist-74.name: Spellcasting
classes/archivist-74.description: Casts divine spells from a prayerbook. Intelligence determines the highest spell level the archivist can learn, prepare, or cast and sets spell save DCs; Wisdom provides bonus spells per day. Spells are prepared after rest and study.

classes/archivist-74.name: Prayerbook
classes/archivist-74.description: Keeps divine spells in a prayerbook and can prepare only spells recorded there, except read magic. Begins with all 0-level cleric spells plus selected 1st-level cleric spells, gains two cleric spells for the prayerbook at each archivist level, and can copy additional divine spells from scrolls under the normal spellbook-copying rules.

classes/archivist-74.name: Dark knowledge
classes/archivist-74.description: 3/day at 1st level, with one additional daily use every three archivist levels. Make the Knowledge check appropriate to the creature type (DC 15); the effect lasts 1 minute unless stated otherwise and normally affects a creature or creatures of the same race within 60 feet. Tactics (1st) grants allies +1 to attack rolls against the affected creatures, improving to +2/+3 when the check beats the DC by 10/20. Puissance (5th) similarly grants +1/+2/+3 on saves against the affected creatures' abilities. Foe (8th) grants +1d6/+2d6/+3d6 weapon damage. Dread Secret (11th) dazzles, dazes, or stuns one target for 1 round depending on the check margin. Foreknowledge (14th) grants allies within 30 feet +1/+2/+3 insight AC against attacks from the affected creature.

classes/archivist-74.name: Scribe Scroll
classes/archivist-74.description: Gains Scribe Scroll as a bonus feat.

classes/archivist-74.name: Lore mastery
classes/archivist-74.description: Gain +2 on Decipher Script checks and on one chosen Knowledge skill. Choose another Knowledge skill for this +2 bonus at 7th, 13th, and 17th level; each choice is permanent.

classes/archivist-74.name: Still mind
classes/archivist-74.description: Gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against enchantment spells and effects.

classes/archivist-74.name: Bonus feat
classes/archivist-74.description: At 10th level and again at 20th level, choose a bonus feat from Skill Focus (any Knowledge skill), Spell Focus, any metamagic feat, or any item creation feat.

classes/psion-137.name: Class Skills
classes/psion-137.description: Your chosen psionic discipline adds class skills. Seer adds Gather Information, Listen, and Spot; Shaper adds Bluff, Disguise, and Use Psionic Device; Kineticist adds Autohypnosis, Disable Device, and Intimidate; Egoist adds Autohypnosis, Balance, and Heal; Nomad adds Climb, Jump, Ride, Survival, and Swim; Telepath adds Bluff, Diplomacy, Gather Information, and Sense Motive.

classes/psion-137.name: Weapon and Armor Proficiency
classes/psion-137.description: Proficient with the club, dagger, heavy crossbow, light crossbow, quarterstaff, and shortspear. Psions are not proficient with armor or shields, and armor does not interfere with manifesting powers.

classes/psion-137.name: Power Points/Day
classes/psion-137.description: Manifesting powers spends power points. Your base daily power-point allotment follows the Psion progression table, and a high Intelligence score can grant bonus power points; race, feats, and items can also add power points.

classes/psion-137.name: Discipline
classes/psion-137.description: Choose one psionic discipline at 1st level. It grants its associated class skills and access to powers restricted to that discipline; you cannot normally learn powers restricted to the other disciplines.

classes/psion-137.name: Powers Known
classes/psion-137.description: Begin with three psion powers known and learn additional powers as you gain levels. You may choose general psion powers and powers from your chosen discipline, but not powers restricted to other disciplines unless another rule allows it. You do not prepare powers; after a good night's rest you regain spent power points. A power's save DC is 10 + power level + Intelligence modifier.

classes/psion-137.name: Maximum Power Level Known
classes/psion-137.description: The highest-level power you can learn increases with Psion level according to the class table. To learn or manifest a power, your Intelligence score must be at least 10 + the power's level.

classes/psion-137.name: Bonus Feats
classes/psion-137.description: Gain a bonus feat at 1st, 5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th level. Each of these class bonus feats must be a psionic feat, metapsionic feat, or psionic item creation feat; they are in addition to normal character-level feats.
